name: blueprint/dogfood-session
description: Exploratory QA of your own app: drive it, capture evidence per finding (steps + actual vs expected), store the session, and emit one bug report - repro wins over opinion.
use_cases: track the session for the weekly review
ingredients: browser tools / rh_run curl for the poking
rh_store dogfood:<session>:<n> evidence records { steps, expected, actual }
rh_notify_send when a blocker-level bug is found
recipe: open the app -> for each finding: record steps + expected + actual -> severity via rh_text_classify (blocker/major/minor/nit) -> session summary via rh_text_summarise -> blocker: notify once -> the records feed the weekly review
result_kind: one evidence record per finding + one session report
cost_hint: one classify per finding + one summarise per session
pitfalls: actual vs expected is the evidence - opinion is not
record steps BEFORE the fix, or the repro evaporates
blocker alert needs an alert-once record
